title: Should we rewrite the sync feature?
subtitle: One question: is sync worth what it costs to keep?

data.question: Is sync worth what it costs to keep?
howto: Work in ink, in the colours on this page.
When the time is up, stop mid-sentence.
Photograph every page and send them back.

pages.title: Empty the tank
pages.prompt: Everything you currently think about sync, before you sort any of it.

pages.title: Weigh the paths
pages.prompt: Score each path against what actually matters here, then a gut score in a second pen.

pages.title: It is six months from now and it failed
pages.prompt: Imagine the rewrite shipped and made things worse. Write the post-mortem.
